summary: The note describes Julie, an American sitcom starring Julie Andrews that aired on ABC from May 30 to July 4, 1992. It notes that Blake Edwards, Andrews' husband at the time, served as the series' director and executive producer.
one_line: Julie is a 1992 American sitcom starring Julie Andrews, broadcast on ABC, directed and executive produced by Blake Edwards.
key_facts: Julie is an American sitcom starring Julie Andrews.
Julie aired from May 30 to July 4, 1992.
Blake Edwards was the director of the Julie series.
Blake Edwards was the executive producer of the Julie series.
Blake Edwards was Julie Andrews' husband at the time the series aired.
